use_readings.readability: Both read directly in the width-720 view in the large orange bottom panel, white text on two lines.

evidence.emotion_control: Orange repeats the tool handles to mark the practical action; the energetic scale serves application findability rather than being gratuitous decoration.

evidence.mandatory: Native PNG 1086 × 1448; target 3:4; relative ratio error 0.00000%, within 1%. One flat artwork, with all fourteen required text items visible and readable at width720. residuals: The large top title and bottom application panel compress the central information into a busy middle zone.
The URL ends close to the panel's right inset, but all characters remain inside and readable.
The visible hinge interaction is plausible; hidden internal geometry is not physically tested.

garden-title-only.evidence: These five identified members have distinct working ideas: rising botanical specimen with bottom title (X316), positive/negative large flower silhouette with an embedded band (X128), plant and enlarged wall shadow with dark wall-like type (X638), immersive photographic garden path with serif title (X504), and vines growing around a staggered type structure (X960). X316/X960 are closest in their pale botanical rendering, dark field, and heavy cream lettering; their specimen-led versus letter-led spatial roles still differ substantially. The judgment uses these five members only.
residuals: X316's typography 3 remains the least integrated title/image relation in the current set; diversity does not repair that weakness.
Dark fields and pale blooms recur across several members, but they are not merely filter/color changes of one structure.

coast-cleanup-dense-action.evidence: The only pair contrasts a horizontal preparatory equipment still life with captions (X125) and a vertical in-situ bottle pickup with type on beach sand (X844). Image scale, action, placement, and the caption role materially differ, while familiar navy bold headlines and pale fields are a common structural habit. Only these two current deliverables count.
residuals: Both use broadly similar heavy navy information lettering; diversity is convincing but not maximally distinct.
X125's hierarchy remains functional rather than exceptionally nuanced, and X844's long cancellation line extends toward the textured bag edge.

foln-product-mixed-copy.evidence: X486 explains two cup states in a white studio pair with copy beside and below them; X640 gives a close tactile compression gesture with a cropped hand, detached lid, gray surface, and a split large title. These differ in subject action, spatial weight, and type role while preserving the specified product and readable copy. The same green lettering and broadly similar product rendering keep a family resemblance. Comparisons are excluded.
residuals: The paired images share an ordinary sans type voice and realistic product finish, but these serve the product requirement rather than warranting a style penalty.
X486 retains slightly soft text edges and a somewhat detached bottom information group.

heldout-repair-cafe-dense.evidence: X186 uses a photograph-like magnifier over fraying fabric and a square two-column reading structure; X225 uses cooperative illustrated hands repairing a wooden box in a vertical composition with facts around the action. Inspection versus shared repair, photographic versus illustrated material treatment, image crop, and information placement are persuasive separate directions. Both retain a large sans title above conventional information groups. Only the two current members are assessed.
residuals: Both retain a familiar top title and utility-type approach; the set has strong substantive separation but some structural sameness.
X186's column shift and right-side blank gaps, and X225's weaker thumbnail action emphasis, remain individual issues.

pair1.reason: B (X844) gives the deadline and full URL a much clearer intermediate scale than A (X384), while retaining the readable practical copy and coherent cleanup scene. This directly serves the stated action requirement.
pair1.uncertainty: A has a slightly quieter application block and stronger event-date presence; the preference concerns information priority, not a detectable material-quality difference.

pair2.reason: B (X125) uses weight changes and slightly calmer spacing to distinguish headline, event information, captions, and bottom notes more clearly than A (X887). Both make the deadline and URL readable and use the same visible equipment idea.
pair2.uncertainty: The improvement is modest; both remain functional, and native grabber contact is partly obscured in both.

pair3.reason: B (X486) groups FOLN with the product name and reduces the isolated upper blank band of A (X728). The cup-state demonstration and required copy remain clear, so the choice is driven by spatial and typographic integration.
pair3.uncertainty: A's isolated brand could be a deliberate branding emphasis; no brand-system context was supplied, and the preference is not for white space in itself.

pair4.reason: B (X640) enlarges the tactile demonstration and connects the split Fold/Cup title, slogan, and capacity into one left block. A (X337) has more competing alignments and an oversized FOLN that dominates the useful gesture.
pair4.uncertainty: A gives release information greater bottom emphasis. B's lid is cropped, while A's lid contact is harder to locate; neither supports a physical mechanism claim.

pair5.reason: B (X638) places a compact dark title in the illuminated wall gap, preserving the projected stem and joining the wall/shadow treatment. A (X619) has strong white legibility but its centered title crosses the shadow and feels more overlaid.
pair5.uncertainty: A has stronger text contrast, especially in a darker display environment; both titles remain legible in the supplied views, and exact shadow projection is unverified.

pair6.reason: B (X219) makes the deadline and full URL unmistakable in a large orange bottom panel while preserving the cooperative repair image and readable conditions. A (X225) integrates application beside the scene well but gives it less thumbnail priority.
pair6.uncertainty: A is spatially quieter and less dense in the middle. The orange panel is rewarded for required findability and tool-color relation, not for a preferred style.

pair7.reason: A (X186) restores a useful title/application hierarchy and calmer right-column conditions. B (X251) magnifies the repair-guarantee, item, and filming paragraphs until they rival the recruitment title and subordinate the application details.
pair7.uncertainty: Both pass visible copy and width720 readability, and both share coherent fabric/magnifier imagery; the preference is a substantial editorial hierarchy judgment.
